# AI Trainer Academy

> AI Trainer Academy is the specialist platform for AI training, data annotation, and AI model training education. We connect learners with verified AI trainers and offer structured certifications.

## What We Do

AI Trainer Academy is a marketplace and learning platform that:
- Connects learners with verified AI trainers for 1-on-1 sessions and courses
- Provides a structured AI training curriculum covering RLHF, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and data annotation
- Issues verifiable AI trainer certifications upon exam completion
- Offers corporate AI training programs for teams and enterprises

## Who We Serve

- **Learners**: Developers, data scientists, and professionals who want to learn AI model training, data annotation, and prompt engineering hands-on
- **AI Trainers**: ML engineers, NLP researchers, and AI practitioners who want to monetize their expertise by teaching
- **Businesses**: Companies that need to upskill their engineering teams in AI model training and data annotation workflows

## Key Topics Covered

- AI Training and AI Model Training
- Data Annotation and AI Data Labeling
- Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
- LLM Fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT)
- Prompt Engineering
- Dataset Curation and Benchmark Evaluation
- AI Safety and Alignment
- RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems
- MLOps and Model Deployment

## Platform Facts

- Trainers keep 80% of all revenue (highest share in the industry)
- Payments supported: M-Pesa, card (Paystack), USDT (Binance Pay)
- Currencies: KES, USD, crypto
- Trainer verifications: All trainers are manually vetted practitioners
- Geographic focus: Global, with a strong base in Africa (Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa)
